title: Global Partners LP (GLP) Files 10-K for the Fiscal Year Ended on December 31, 2017
text:
2018-03-18 14:56:35 AAPL,BABA,FB,NFLX,P,SNAP,TWTR, 
In the last few weeks, we have seen two high profile unicorns file for initial public offerings. The first out of the gate was Dropbox (Pending:DBX), a storage solution for a world where gigabyte files are the rule rather than the exception, with a filing on February 23. Following close after, Global Partners LP (GLP) Files 10-K for the Fiscal Year Ended on December 31, 2017 
Global Partners LP (NYSE:GLP) files its latest 10-K with SEC for the fiscal year ended on December 31, 2017. 
For the last quarter Global Partners LP reported a revenue of $2.2 billion, compared with the revenue of $2 billion during the same period a year ago. For the latest fiscal year the company reported a revenue of $8.9 billion, an increase of 8.3% from last year. For the last five years Global Partners LP had an average revenue decline of 17% a year. 
The reported diluted earnings per share was $1.74 for the year, an increase of -129.4% from previous year. The Global Partners LP had an operating margin of 1.34%, compared with the operating margin of -1.85% a year before. The 10-year historical median operating margin of Global Partners LP is 0.57%. The profitability rank of the company is 4 (out of 10). 
At the end of the fiscal year, Global Partners LP has the cash and cash equivalents of $14.9 million, compared with $10.0 million in the previous year. The long term debt was $1.1 billion, compared with $1.2 billion in the previous year. The interest coverage to the debt is 1.4, which is not a favorable level. Global Partners LP has a financial strength rank of 6 (out of 10). 
At the current stock price of $16.50, Global Partners LP is traded at 25.9% premium to its historical median P/S valuation band of $13.11. The P/S ratio of the stock is 0.06, while the historical median P/S ratio is 0.05. The stock lost 4.43% during the past 12 months.
